options.codec_tip.compatible: Every video becomes an MP4 with H.264 picture and AAC sound, which phones, TVs and Windows' own player open. Videos already in H.264 are moved over without quality loss; HEVC (iPhone), MJPEG, WMV, MPEG-2 … are re-encoded (the eye cannot tell, but it takes time). iPhone's HDR videos are converted to SDR with their colors kept.
options.codec_tip.keep: The picture and sound are moved into MP4 with as little re-encoding as possible (very fast; the quality does not change at all). HEVC videos stay HEVC, which some older devices, and Windows without the HEVC extension, may not open. Codecs MP4 cannot hold (MJPEG, WMV, MPEG-2 …) still become H.264.
options.convert_hint: HEIC, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, GIF and RAW files become JPG.
options.convert_hint_keep: HEIC, PNG, WebP, RAW … become JPG. With 'Remove Hidden Details' off, the camera details are kept.
options.folder_hint: The selected photos and videos gather here; the originals do not change.
options.group_hint: Date: the capture date, or else the date in the file name. Undated files go into the 'Undated' folder.
options.group_tip.source: The folders you selected are recreated in the save folder with their names and subfolders (e.g. Archive\2019\Holiday). Files selected one by one go into a folder named after their own folder.
options.hw_encoder_hdr: Encoder: {name}. With 'Fast and lossless' chosen, cropped HDR videos stay HDR.
options.hw_none: This computer has no usable GPU encoder; videos are encoded on the CPU.
options.hw_tip:
Videos that need re-encoding (HEVC → H.264, cropping, straightening …) are encoded with the GPU's encoder (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel Quick Sync, AMD AMF or Windows Media Foundation): several times faster, the files may be a little larger.
If the encoder cannot be opened, fails or makes a broken picture, the video is encoded on the CPU (x264) instead.
options.in_place_delete: The files are changed in their own folders and the originals are deleted PERMANENTLY.
options.in_place_recycle: The files are changed in their own folders; the originals can be restored from the Recycle Bin.
options.in_place_warn: The files are changed in their own folders.
options.keep_date_tip:
While the hidden details are removed, only the capture date and time stay: in photos as a single EXIF field, in videos in the file header. The file's own date becomes the capture date too, so galleries such as Google Photos and iCloud keep the order.
The location, camera, serial number, time zone and everything else are removed all the same. Files without a capture date get none.
options.pattern_tip.date_number: The name is the capture day and the file's number within that day; numbering starts from 1 every day. Files without a capture date become 'Undated_001' ….
options.pattern_tip.date_time: The name is the capture date and time. Files from the same second get _2, _3 …; files without a capture date become 'Undated_1' ….
options.pattern_tip.number: Each file is named with the prefix and a number; photos and videos are numbered separately.
options.prefix_tip: Goes at the start of the photos' new names (optional)
options.profile_tip:
The vivid colors of iPhones and professional cameras (Display P3, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB) are kept: the file gets a clean, standard color profile that names no device or date, so JPEGs are not recompressed.
When off, colors are converted to sRGB so they look the same on every screen and in every program. Profiles that are not recognized are always converted to sRGB.
options.raw_tip:
Camera look: the full-size JPEG the camera made itself, inside the RAW, is used (colors as you saw them on the camera, not recompressed). Without a full-size preview, the RAW data is developed.
Develop from the RAW data: each RAW is developed at full resolution with LibRaw (camera white balance, sRGB).
options.recycle: Move the originals to the Recycle Bin
options.recycle_tip: Recommended: if something goes wrong, you can get the original files back.
options.resize_tip: For sharing: the long side of the photos becomes at most the chosen size; smaller photos stay as they are (never enlarged). A shrunk photo is recompressed.
options.shrink_hint: For sharing. Smaller photos are not enlarged.
options.sort.manual: In the order I chose (by hand)
options.sort.name: By file name (the folder's order)
options.sort_tip.date: The capture date is read from the photo's or video's own details, or else from the file name (IMG_20240512_…). Files without one are not slotted in with a guessed date: they come last, in the order you selected them (the folder's order if you selected a folder). Files with equal dates keep the order you selected them in.
options.sort_tip.manual: The order you selected the files in; drag the rows on the Selected tab to change it.
options.sort_tip.mtime: When the file was last modified (copying or editing can change it). Files with equal times keep the order you selected them in.
options.sort_tip.name: File Explorer's name order (1, 2, 10 …); folder by folder if you selected from several.
options.sort_tip.size: Files of equal size keep the order you selected them in.
options.strip_hint: The location, camera, date and every other hidden detail (metadata) are removed.
options.strip_tip: The location (GPS), camera and serial number, date, author, editing history, embedded thumbnails and every other hidden detail are removed. In videos the location and sensor tracks and the camera details embedded in the picture go too, without re-encoding the picture. Subtitles are kept (apart from tracks that log a location, like DJI's).
options.structure_hint: Files selected in different folders gather in one folder.

options.video_hint.keep: Videos become MP4 with as little re-encoding as possible.
options.video_prefix_tip: Goes at the start of the videos' new names (optional). Videos are numbered apart from the photos.

processor.raw_needs_jpeg: The hidden details in RAW files can only be removed by converting them to JPG; turn on 'Convert Photos to JPG' too.

runner.out_of_memory: Not enough memory: the file is too large to process.
runner.place_failed: The file could not be put in place: {error}
runner.read_only: The file is read-only, so it cannot be changed.
runner.rename_failed: The file could not be renamed: {error}
runner.saved_as: Saved as '{name}', as a file with the same name appeared.
runner.temp_left: The file is left under this temporary name: {path}
runner.write_failed: The file could not be written: {error}

scan.added.one: {where}: {n} file added to the selection (subfolders included).
scan.added.other: {where}: {n} files added to the selection (subfolders included).

scan.none: {where}: no photos or videos found (subfolders included).

scan.some_stopped.one: The scan of {n} folder was stopped.
scan.some_stopped.other: The scans of {n} folders were stopped.

scan.stopped: The scan of {where} was stopped; nothing was selected.

scan.unreadable.one: {n} folder could not be opened (no access).
scan.unreadable.other: {n} folders could not be opened (no access).

selected.clear_tip: Empties the list; the files are not touched

selected.dupes_found.one: {n} copy found and selected. Press 'Remove from List' to take it out of the list; the files are not touched.
selected.dupes_found.other: {n} copies found and selected. Press 'Remove from List' to take them out of the list; the files are not touched.

selected.empty_text: Click files on the 'Browse' tab to select them; what you select in different folders gathers here. To select a whole folder with its subfolders, click the circle on the folder, or its box in the tree on the left. You can also drag files or folders onto the window.
selected.empty_title: No Photos or Videos Selected Yet
selected.find_dupes_tip: Checks whether the list has the same file, or the same picture with other details, more than once; selects the copies for you to remove. No file is deleted.
selected.large_preview_tip: Shows the selected photos large and plays the videos; browse them with the arrows, rotate and crop them (double-click a row, or Space)

selected.leaks.one: {n} file name gives away a date or a device
selected.leaks.other: {n} file names give away a date or a device

selected.leaks_tip: The hidden details go, but the file name stays as it is (e.g. IMG_20240512_143022: the capture date and time). Turn on 'Sort and Rename' to hide the names too.
selected.loading: Reading the files' details; the dates and notes update when it is done.
selected.manual_hint: Drag the rows, or use the up/down buttons, to change the order.
selected.note.audio_aac: The sound will be converted to AAC
selected.note.clash: A number was added to the name because the target already has a file with that name
selected.note.copy: Copy: the same picture as '{name}'. You can remove it from the list.
selected.note.name_leak: The file name stays, but {leak}. Turn on 'Sort and Rename' to hide it.
selected.note.reencode: The picture will be re-encoded: {reasons} (at a quality the eye cannot tell apart; {how})
selected.note.remux: Will be moved into {fmt} without re-encoding (the quality does not change)
selected.note.tonemap: HDR ({hdr}) → SDR: the colors will be kept by tone mapping
selected.order_hint: Order: {sort}. To order by hand, choose 'In the order I chose' on the right.

selected.order_undated.one: Order: {sort}. The {n} file without a capture date comes last.
selected.order_undated.other: Order: {sort}. The {n} files without a capture date come last, in the order you selected.

selected.order_undated_tip: Undated files keep the order you selected them in on Browse (the folder's order if you selected a folder). To change it, choose 'In the order I chose' on the right, arrange the rows, then sort by date again.
selected.remove_tip: Removes the selected rows from the list; the files are not touched (Delete)
selected.undated_tip:
No capture date; the date shown is when the file was last modified.
Sorting by capture date puts it last, in the order you selected; grouping by date puts it in the 'Undated' folder.
tabs.name: Tabs
tiff.not_tiff: The file is not a TIFF (BigTIFF is not supported).
tree.hint: Ticking a box selects the folder with its subfolders.
tree.tip: Click the name to open it, the box to select all of it.

video.audio_unsupported.one: {n} audio track in an unsupported format could not be copied and was left out.
video.audio_unsupported.other: {n} audio tracks in an unsupported format could not be copied and were left out.

video.damaged: The video is damaged or incomplete: part of it cannot be read.
video.date_container: The capture date ({when}) was kept only as the file's date: a date can be written only into MP4, MOV and 3GP videos.
video.date_file_only: The capture date ({when}) was kept only as the file's date, as it cannot be written into the video.
video.deinterlaced: The interlaced picture was turned into full frames.
video.edit_needs_mp4: This video format cannot be edited as it is; rotating, flipping, cropping and trimming can only be applied while converting to MP4 (turn on 'Convert Videos to MP4' too).
video.empty_all: The trimmed video would be empty: no part of the video is left.
video.empty_end: The trimmed video would be empty: the end point is before the start.
video.empty_start: The trimmed video would be empty: the start point is after the end of the video.
video.failed: The video could not be processed: {error}
video.gpu_failed: The video could not be encoded on the GPU ({encoder}): {reason}. It was encoded on the CPU instead.
video.gpu_used: The picture was encoded on the GPU ({encoder}).
video.hidden_start: As it was trimmed without quality loss, {seconds} s before the start stay hidden in the file (players don't show them). To delete them for good, remove that part with '{cut}'.
video.leftovers: The hidden details could not be removed completely: {items}
video.lost: Left out, as they cannot be carried over to the new format: {items}.
video.no_chapters: The chapter titles could not be carried over.
video.out_of_memory: Not enough memory: the video could not be processed.
video.problem.trailing: data at the end of the file

video.subtitle_skipped.one: {n} subtitle line could not be converted to MP4 and was skipped.
video.subtitle_skipped.other: {n} subtitle lines could not be converted to MP4 and were skipped.

video.tonemapped: The HDR ({hdr}) video was converted to SDR with tone mapping.
video.track.subtitle: subtitle track

video.trimmed_cut.one: The video was trimmed; {n} section was removed (kept: {kept}).
video.trimmed_cut.other: The video was trimmed; {n} sections were removed (kept: {kept}).

video.verify_broken: The encoded picture came out broken (similarity to the source: {db} dB).
video.verify_decode: The picture of the video produced could not be decoded.
video.verify_duration: The video produced has a different length ({duration} s instead of {expected} s).
video.verify_empty: The video could not be written (the output is empty).
video.verify_end: The end of the video produced could not be decoded.
video.verify_open: The video produced could not be opened: {error}
video.verify_packets: The video produced was written incompletely (the packet count does not match).
video.verify_rotation: The video produced has the wrong orientation.
video.verify_sei: The details embedded in the picture stream could not be removed.
video.verify_size: The video produced has the wrong size.
video.verify_structure: The structure of the video produced could not be read: {error}
video.verify_subtitle_log: The hidden details could not be removed completely: a subtitle track holds a location or camera log.
video.verify_tracks: The video produced is missing tracks.
webp.bad_length: The WebP file is damaged (wrong chunk length).
webp.no_header: The WebP file is damaged (no image header found).
webp.not_webp: The file is not a WebP.
winutil.no_bin: The Recycle Bin is supported only on Windows.
xmp.hint.author: author
